{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma2

|version3= 1.00

|game4= arma3
|version4= 0.50

|arg=local

|eff= global

|gr1= Animations

|descr= When used on a person, a smooth transition to the given action will be initiated, but all previous playAction are discarded.
{{Feature|arma3|For {{arma3}} actions, see [[playAction/actions]].}}

|s1= soldier [[playActionNow]] action

|p1= soldier: [[Object]]
|p2= action: [[String]]
|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>soldierOne playActionNow "SitDown";</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>rabbitTwo playActionNow "WalkF";</sqf>

|seealso= [[playAction]] [[switchAction]] [[playMove]] [[playMoveNow]] [[switchMove]]
}}

{{Note
|user= Wolfrug
|timestamp= 20101012094100
|text= Some other possible playactions:
{{Columns|4|
* {{hl|"walkF"}} - walk forward
* {{hl|"walkB"}} - walk backwards
* {{hl|"walkR"}} - strafe right
* {{hl|"walkL"}} - strafe left
* {{hl|"grabDrag"}} - initiate First Aid dragging animation
* {{hl|"stopDrag"}} - stop First Aid dragging animation
* {{hl|"reloadMagazine"}} - reload the current magazine
* {{hl|"gestureFreeze"}} - hand signal "Freeze"
* {{hl|"gestureGo"}}
* {{hl|"gestureCover"}}
* {{hl|"gestureAttack"}}
* {{hl|"gestureCeaseFire"}}
* {{hl|"gestureFollow"}}
* {{hl|"gestureUp"}}
* {{hl|"gestureAdvance"}}
* {{hl|"gesturePoint"}}
}}

Note that playAction works regardless of stance (rifle up, down, crouched, prone).
}}

{{Note
|user= h -
|timestamp= 20230905073658
|text= Playing a gesture with [[playActionNow]] while a soldier held weapon is deployed on something will 'undeploy' the weapon.
Using [[playAction]] doesn't.
}}
